ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'fahashara fanada' signify in Quranic narrative?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah As-Saffat, this fragment depicts the gathering of the council of angels or divine beings who deliberate and proclaim the decree of Allah. It highlights the hierarchical structure of the heavens and the authoritative nature of divine communication, emphasizing that their actions are subject to God's will.
